question: Should maintainers approve this incremental catalog consumer as the second, inactive stage after the signed-shard consumer lands, while deferring production-key and deployed-endpoint activation?
rationale: The patch adds a compatibility- and security-sensitive signed-feed protocol layer, and its required predecessor remains open; acceptance of the staged rollout boundary is a maintainer product and security decision.

options.title: Approve staged sequencing
options.body: Merge the signed-shard consumer first, rebase this PR, and keep the incremental path inactive until the separate production activation proof is ready.

options.title: Pause for activation package
options.body: Defer this consumer until the production signing key, deployed endpoint, and live activation evidence can be reviewed together.
